versions.subject: Converted Sysmon/1 and Security/4688 to generic process creation rules
Fixed commandline to detect any shim install from any location
fix: fixed missing date fields in remaining files
fix: FP tuning for IIS Express and making use of value modifiers
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith:
        - '\sdbinst.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '.sdb'
filter:
    - CommandLine|contains:
        - 'iisexpressshim.sdb' # normal behaviour for IIS Express (e.g. https://www.hybrid-analysis.com/sample/15d4ff941f77f7bdfc9dfb2399b7b952a0a2c860976ef3e835998ff4796e5e91?environmentId=120)
condition: selection and not filter
